content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text enters an UNDERDETERMINED verdict for Isaiah 7:14 based on the parties' separate answers about the verse's wording and application, so it does the thing K-S2 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"'A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand': I weighed a narrow reading limited to two lexical senses against a reading that also covers two aspects of the same verse such as virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application.","why":"The judge makes the verse UNDERDETERMINED by treating its separately answered wording and application as leaving the issue open, but K-S2 says both senses stand and such a verse is not open."}
